SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date = '2012-08-24' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Date = '2012-08-24' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 100 FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25'
SELECT T2.GasStationID FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID ORDER BY T1.Amount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Country = 'SVK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Country = 'SVK'

SELECT SUM(T2.Amount) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '201201' AND T1.GasStationID = (SELECT GasStationID FROM gasstations WHERE ChainID = 1 AND Country = 'USA' AND Segment = 'Gas') AND T1.CustomerID = 38508
SELECT T2.Description FROM products AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID ORDER BY T1.Amount DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT T1.CustomerID, AVG(T2.Price) / AVG(T2.Amount) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID GROUP BY T1.CustomerID ORDER BY AVG(T2.Price) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.Country FROM customers AS T1 JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID JOIN products AS T3 ON T2.ProductID = T3.ProductID WHERE T3.ProductID = 2 ORDER BY T3.Price DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.ConsumptionStatus FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '201208' AND T2.ProductID = 5 AND T2.Price / T2.Amount > 29.00
